title: It's Snowing Really Hard Today
synopsis:
It's snowing, and Anne is taking the bus to the phone store to buy a phone. She meets Teacher Bai, on the bus. Teacher Bai teaches core subjects, and he and Anne start chatting.
In this lesson, you will learn to talk about what types of weather you like and discuss your personal experiences and feelings through the romantic story of Teacher Bai and his wife.

fullText.simplified:
今天的雪真大

白老师：Anne，晚上好！
Anne：白老师？晚上好！您回家吗？今天的雪真大，您怎么没开车？
白老师：我回家。下雪的时候，我喜欢坐公共汽车。
Anne：您喜欢下雪，对吗？
白老师：我喜欢下雪。Anne，你呢？
Anne：我不喜欢，下雪太冷了。我喜欢晴天。
白老师：我第一次见到我妻子时，她也说不喜欢下雪，也觉得下雪太冷了。
Anne：真的吗？那她现在喜欢下雪了吗？
白老师：现在她非常喜欢下雪。
Anne：为什么呢？
白老师：因为我喜欢，所以她也喜欢了。但是她不知道，我为什么喜欢下雪。
Anne：这是什么意思？您为什么喜欢下雪呢？
白老师：第一次见到我妻子时，我们都是大学生。那天也是下雪天，她上了公共汽车，但是没钱买车票，因为她的钱包找不到了。
Anne：您帮她买了车票吗？
白老师：对，我帮她买了车票，她对我说了谢谢。她坐在我左边，离我很近，我们开始说话。她问我喜不喜欢下雪，她说她不喜欢下雪，因为下雪太冷了。
Anne：从那时候开始，您就喜欢她了吗？
白老师：是的，从那天开始，我就喜欢她了。那天的雪和公共汽车，我也很喜欢。
Anne：啊！我知道您为什么喜欢在下雪的时候坐公共汽车了！

Anne：您幫她買了車票嗎？

sentence_translations: It’s Snowing Really Hard Today
Teacher Bai: Anne, good evening!
Anne: Teacher Bai? Good evening! Are you going home? It’s snowing really hard today. Why aren’t you driving?
Teacher Bai: I’m going home. When it snows, I like to take the bus.
Anne: You like the snow, right?
Teacher Bai: I like the snow. Anne, how about you?
Anne: I don’t like it. It’s too cold when it snows. I like sunny days.
Mr. Bai: The first time I met my wife, she also said she didn’t like snow and also that it was too cold when it snowed.
Anne: Really? Then does she like the snow now?
Teacher Bai: She really likes the snow now.
Anne: Why is that?
Teacher Bai: Because I like it, so she also likes it. But she doesn’t know why I like the snow.
Anne: What do you mean? So why do you like the snow?
Teacher Bai: The first time I met my wife, we were both college students.
That day was also a snowy day. She got on the bus, but she didn’t have money to buy a ticket because she couldn’t find her purse.
Anne: Did you buy her a ticket?
Teacher Bai: Yes, I bought her a ticket, and she thanked me. She sat to my left, very close to me. We started talking.
She asked me if I liked the snow. She said she didn’t like the snow because it was too cold when it snowed.
Anne: You started liking her from that moment?
Teacher Bai: Yes, I started liking her from that day on. I also really liked the snow and the bus on that day.
Anne: Ah! Now I know why you like to take the bus when it’s snowing!
